text_block_list.text:
One day. Mejiro McQueen came to consult
with Mejiro Palmer.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"You asked Ikuno to hang out so she could relax for a change?
Whew, that's awesome☆"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
However, um...!
I just can't get my plans together at all...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Ikuno-san is delighted by anything.
So when I try to think of what she truly loves,
I find myself at a loss...
choice_data_list: So you still haven't decided, huh.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
All right, if it's planning, I'll help out!
First, why don't you tell me what you want to do?
Let me know what things are absolute musts!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Um, Ikuno-san likes cycling, so... maybe something active...?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Sounds great, doesn't it?
Speaking of places where we can get some exercise...

My, are you talking about muscles?
May I join in as well~?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Sorry for listening in without asking. But it sounded like you were in trouble.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Please, allow us to lend a helping hand as well.
I can introduce you to the muscle spots I've visited with Ryan-oneesama~

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
...! Thank you very much,
please do teach me!

And so, the support team was formed,
and the day of the outing arrived...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Both McQueen and Ikuno are walking right along the planned course! No problems so far!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...I feel restless.
Is it really okay for me to be watching?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
However, this request came directly from Lady McQueen herself.
Let us watch over her quietly, and if anything happens, we can jump in and save the day~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: —Ah, oh no! The crowd is... I think we might have lost McQueen and the others!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
McQueen-san! Where are you going?
...She isn't answering.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: "The golden rule in these situations is to stay put... but having McQueen-san search for me feels wrong... Maybe I should go look for her after all..."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Yoo-hoo, Ikuno!
Fancy meeting you here~ What's going on?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Y-Yes... Um, actually, right nowâ

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Ikuno-san!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: I am deeply sorry! For someone like me to go and carelessly get separated...!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
No, I am the one who should apologize.
Shall we hold hands so we don't get separated here?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Y-Yes...!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Well then, we shall take our leave here.
Have a wonderful day, Palmer-san and everyone.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Huff, puff. I somehow managed to relay
Lady Ikuno's position to Lady McQueen~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Palmer and the others bought time for Ikuno,
so she was able to meet up with us properly, right?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
All done~! Great job, everyone!
Our outing can safely resume!
choice_data_list: Let's keep this up and do our best next time too!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Um, first we swim with dolphins here,
take a long walk, and then head to the park's restaurant.
I think that's it, maybe—
(Gurgle rumble rumble~)
choice_data_list: That sound just now... did it come from those two...?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Ah, u-um...
No, that sound just now was...!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, shall we move up our schedule
and head to the restaurant in the park first?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
...! But then you won't be able to
participate in the swimming with dolphins experience!
I'm fine, really...!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Let's look forward to it next time.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
No, I couldn't possibly...
? Please excuse me for just a moment...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
...! Ikuno-san, let's head to the museum café!
I heard they have a limited-edition spotted seal
Japanese sesame cream parfait!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
All right, crisis averted!
I'm so glad you noticed my message~!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: If we can eat inside the facility, we'll still be able to join the swimming experience as planned.
And so, watching over together with the Mejiro family—Mejiro McQueen's outing was led to a grand success...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Phew... Those two looked like they were having a blast!
And they lived happily ever after!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
This is Mejiro teamwork for ya~!
Just kidding, ehehe.
choice_data_list: We were totally in sync, wasn't it?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. We've known each other for a long time
through thick and thin, after all...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Even with circumstances like these...
I guess it turned out to be kind of nice, you know?
choice_data_list: Then here's to a huge success!
Why don't all of you Mejiros go hang out sometime?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
! Totally!
We've gotta toast to the support team's success!

"Sharing the joy of working together...
we bumped fists to celebrate
our success in the support role."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"If we go," you say... Why are you acting like it doesn't involve you?
Who were the ones sharing the joy today?
Bright, Dober, McQueen, and me, plus who?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Yes, Trainer! Of course you should join in!
